title: Surreal Dream Collage
description: A composite surreal painting divided into four quadrants. Top left shows a blue glowing figure reaching toward a large green planet with a chameleon-like creature and leafy forms. Top right features a somber pale child with dark hair and a purple flower. Bottom left depicts a rabbit in a wooden boat floating on water near purple flowers. Bottom right shows a beautiful red-haired woman with a flower crown and bare shoulders.
prompt: Surreal fantasy collage painting divided into four distinct scenes. Top left: a glowing blue ethereal figure reaching toward a massive green planet with a large chameleon emerging from leafy structures. Top right: a somber young child with pale skin, dark hair, and large eyes wearing a dark robe with purple flowers. Bottom left: anthropomorphic rabbit in a wooden boat floating through swirling water surrounded by vibrant purple flowers and green leaves. Bottom right: beautiful young woman with red hair, flower crown, blue eyes, and bare shoulders against a pink background. Dramatic glowing light burst in the center connecting all scenes, emotional and dreamlike atmosphere.
